notes_for_editor: Story is below the 120-word floor: the only lookout-specific source is an index entry that gives the county and nothing else. Two USGS names are the only other evidence: an atmosphere site called Rose Creek Fire Tower and a well called SRWMD DOF - Rose Creek Tower near Lake City. The USGS pages do not date either or say whether a tower stands. The brief coordinates (30.10362, -82.60803) sit close to the well site (30.10357, -82.60845) and the atmosphere site (30.10301, -82.60901). The 1996 Columbia County history (lakecityhistory.com page 244) has an undated photo caption about an early 1930s lookout tower and weather shed that does not name a site, so it is not used. Do not confuse with the Forest Service Columbia County Communications Tower north of Benton Tower Road, which is a 250-foot communications tower.
